newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent jumps up on Iraq missile report.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent jumps up on Iraq missile report.

text.p: IPE Brent bounced off lows on Tuesday afternoon on a report that United Nations inspectors have discovered that Iraq has continued to develop missiles in contravention of U.N. resolutions.

March Brent was trading seven cents down at $22.47 at 1709 GMT, having jumped some 15 cents on a report from a German newspaper which said that the United States was considering a possible missile strike against Iraq in response.
Feb gas oil also climbed off lows to trade just 50 cents down at $203.50 shortly before its close, off a low of $202 a tonne.
